summary: Partners Group Lending Fund, LLC filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of Class I units and routine monthly NAV and distribution disclosures. As of September 1, 2026, the Fund sold 3,966,155 Class I units for $6.0 million under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D to accredited investors; no Class M units sold. NAV per unit was $1.5128 at August 31, 2026, aggregate NAV about $320.3 million against roughly $224.0 million of debt. A $0.0285 per unit distribution is payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record September 25, 2026. This is an ordinary interval-fund capital raise, not a special situation.
